sources.text: AcmeSync supports HTTP and SOCKS5 proxies but not PAC files. Configure the proxy under Preferences, Network.
Forum answer from 2021: AcmeSync reads PAC files automatically, so you never need to configure a proxy by hand.
Card refunds reach the customer within five to ten business days after the refund is issued in AcmePay.
Deleted files remain in the AcmeSync trash for 30 days and are then permanently erased.
Version 7.2 extends the AcmeSync trash retention for business plans from 30 to 90 days.
AcmePay status report for March: there were no incidents and every AcmePay service stayed operational.

claims: AcmeSync supports PAC files for proxy configuration.
A card refund takes between five and ten business days.
Deleted files stay in the trash for 30 days.
AcmeSync has a native client for Linux.
